description: Source-comment removal, one workspace package at a time: census the banned comments into a ledger, classify each row twice in independent sessions (tautology, stale, excuse, decision record, hazard, narration, grouping, licence), write decision files before deleting decision records, then apply the agreed deletions behind an AST-identity proof and prune the comment-law pending shard. Use on `/delete-comment <package>`, "delete the comments in X", "strip code comments", "sweep the comment law in X", or when `beep laws comments` reports a scope to sweep. NOT for pull-request review comments or threads (yeet), public JSDoc authoring (jsdoc-annotation-specialist), or schema refactors (crispen).
